section.p: Local version 1.2.0 requires DITA-OT 4.4.1 or newer and Java 17 or newer. Runtime verification uses standalone DITA-OT 4.4.2 and Oxygen 29's bundled DITA-OT 4.4.1 with Java 25. Newer toolkits require fresh verification.
The Maven build uses the DOST 4.3.0 API artifact because this is the latest API artifact available on Maven Central. The runtime distribution tested is 4.4.2.

Install the standalone plug-in ZIP into a chosen toolkit. Oxygen's bundled toolkit integration and command-line exports were tested. Oxygen Author/UI rendering and other custom host frameworks were not tested.
